items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: We quit him after that... I had that job for five years.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Need music to make a living.

So did Frankie Dooson need music to make a living? That's all I know was a dude. Never knew him to work. He had so many women to say, but he wasn't much of his act like that. He had no clothes, you know. Then he'd come and tell stories. When you think you're out, he'd go tell your people, you let him the trombone, he'd point it to you. But he said, you ain't home, you go there and get it and say, he told him to come there and get it. But we didn't tell him, you know. We quit him after that, you know. He was quite…
Where did you work with Wesley Dones?
